description: Picks a Glass theme for the Show dashboard from sun elevation and weather. Holidays: Halloween nights Oct 24-31, the snowy Christmas scene on December nights, Christmas Day daytime on Dec 25, Thanksgiving daytime from the Monday to the Sunday of Thanksgiving week. Also switches the Kitchen Echo's own screens (TECHO5 Theme mode) between its custom light theme (sky #96d3f0) and dark theme (night #132e48): dark with the dark glass themes, light otherwise.

variables.glass: {% set el = state_attr('sun.sun','elevation')|float(0) %}{% set rising = state_attr('sun.sun','rising') %}{% set w = states('weather.forecast_home') %}{% set n = now() %}{% set tg = 22 + ((3 - n.replace(month=11, day=1).weekday()) % 7) %}{% set thanks = n.month == 11 and n.day >= tg - 3 and n.day <= tg + 3 %}{% set hallow = n.month == 10 and n.day >= 24 %}{% set december = n.month == 12 %}{% set xmas_day = december and n.day == 25 %}{% if el < -6 %}{{ 'Glass Halloween' if hallow else ('Glass Christmas' if december else 'Glass Night') }}{% elif xmas_day %}Glass Christmas Day{% elif thanks %}Glass Thanksgiving{% elif el < 8 %}{{ 'Glass Dawn' if rising else 'Glass Dusk' }}{% elif w in ['rainy','pouring','lightning','lightning-rainy','hail','snowy','snowy-rainy'] %}Glass Rain{% elif w in ['cloudy','fog','windy','windy-variant','exceptional'] %}Glass Cloudy{% else %}Glass Day{% endif %}
variables.echo_mode: {{ 'Dark' if glass in ['Glass Rain', 'Glass Dusk', 'Glass Night', 'Glass Halloween', 'Glass Christmas'] else 'Light' }}
